title: FriendWorld
tagline: Friend World helps you find and make new friends
description: Everyone deserves friends. The power of friendship can help you. We became isolated because of technologies and pandemic. Friend World helps you make new friends based on interest. A person can connect to their wallet and register their profile. They can enter the form with their name and favorite subject. They can chat with other people
how_its_made: Solidity is used for coding the smart-contract. Smart contract is deployed on Polygon testnet. Website is built with React. XMTP for providing chat functionality between friends. Worldcoin widget is used in the frontend and smart contract to ensure that the new friend is a real person.
